# Kee

> Kee is a management platform for Indian duplicate-key shops, covering
> customer registration, key/master catalogs, store inventory and reports.

- [Home](https://keyshops.in/): Overview of the Kee platform.
- [Find a Shop](https://keyshops.in/search): Search Kee-powered key shops by name, city or category.
- [About](https://keyshops.in/about): Background on Kee and who it's built for.
- [Contact](https://keyshops.in/contact): Support and contact details.
